# Condition Evaluation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ConditionEvaluation`](gmeow-ConditionEvaluation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ConditionEvaluation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An observation that a condition held, did not hold, or could not be determined at some moment — vantage = the evaluator (an agent, a solver run, a model). The verdict is a recorded observation, NEVER a graph entailment: two evaluators returning different verdicts for one condition are two coexisting cells ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). The evaluation run itself attaches via [`gmeow:observationEvent`](../properties/gmeow-observationEvent.md); the evaluated condition rides [`gmeow:evaluatedCondition`](../properties/gmeow-evaluatedCondition.md) ⊑ [`gmeow:observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ConditionEvaluation`](gmeow-ConditionEvaluation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record that an evaluator found a condition held, did not hold, or was undetermined at some moment — a vantage-indexed observation, never a graph entailment.

### Avoid when

- Avoid treating a verdict as global truth (two evaluators may return different verdicts that coexist — [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid having validation tooling execute the condition to produce it ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Mint the evaluation, name the condition with [`gmeow:evaluatedCondition`](../properties/gmeow-evaluatedCondition.md), the outcome with [`gmeow:evaluationVerdict`](../properties/gmeow-evaluationVerdict.md), and carry the evaluator as the observation vantage; group members get their own evaluations.

### Examples

- ex:ev1 a [`gmeow:ConditionEvaluation`](gmeow-ConditionEvaluation.md); [`gmeow:evaluatedCondition`](../properties/gmeow-evaluatedCondition.md) ex:c1; [`gmeow:evaluationVerdict`](../properties/gmeow-evaluationVerdict.md) [`gmeow:verdictHeld`](../individuals/gmeow-verdictHeld.md).
